$comment: CPE-1594 ratchet, made CASE-granular by CPE-1677. Each entry is ONE test case (`spec` = the spec file's basename, `test` = the it() title, verbatim) that is ALLOWED to fail today. Any OTHER case failing reds the job — including a case inside a spec file that already has entries here, which is exactly the hole CPE-1677 closed (whole-file exemptions meant the other 24 cases in samples.smoke.ts guarded nothing). Removing an entry is one-way: once a listed case passes, the ratchet FAILS until its entry is deleted. A listed `test` that matches NO case in the run also FAILS (titles drift; a rename must not silently drop both the exemption and the coverage). Entries are exact titles, never patterns — a pattern would re-create the blanket exemption this replaced. An entry with "intermittent": true is a case PROVEN to both pass and fail on unchanged code (cite the runs in its reason): it is exempt in both directions, because a coin-flip case would otherwise red every run one way or the other — but it must still exist, and the ratchet prints it with its observed status on every run so it stays visible until it is fixed and deleted. See gui-smoke/README.md 'The ratchet' for the retire procedure.

cases.test: opens the Trash from the Sidebar and selects the real, natively-seeded deleted entry
cases.reason: CONFIRMED root cause, via run 32676997154 / job 97288403795 (shard 4)'s raw log and its trash-titlebar-fail.png artifact: 'element click intercepted' clicking the Sidebar's Open-Trash row on ubuntu-latest/WebKitGTK, NOT the msedgedriver-150-vs-Edge-151 hang an earlier version of this entry wrongly cited (that mismatch is Windows-only — msedgedriver never runs on this ubuntu leg at all, and 'GUI smoke (windows-latest)' shows 'skipping' on this PR, so it never touched this failure). The button's own rect at click time was {x:20, y:644, width:193, height:30} in the test's 1000×700 window (getWindowRect confirmed). DropStackPanel.svelte's always-rendered '.drop-stack-handle' toggle (position: fixed; left: 14px; bottom: 14px; z-index: 149; a 28px-tall button, unconditional — only the EXPANDED panel is behind the open/closed `{#if}`) sits at y≈658–686, x≈14–125 in that same window — a real, measured rectangular overlap with the Open-Trash row's own rect, not a coincidence. This is a PRE-EXISTING bug in Sidebar.svelte/DropStackPanel.svelte (neither touched by CPE-1827): a tall enough expanded sidebar pushes bottom rows (Trash's 'Open Trash', and anything else in that band, e.g. the sidebar-reset-row) underneath the floating Drop Stack handle's real click-catching footprint. Out of CPE-1827's own scope (a titlebar-layout ticket) to fix inside that PR — flagged for its own follow-up ticket rather than patched here under time pressure on a shared, unrelated file. Will NOT clear on its own once that ticket lands unless it also changes the Sidebar/DropStackPanel test seams enough to move the Open-Trash row out of the overlap band — remove this entry once fixed and confirmed green, not automatically.
